description: This file defines the class TemplateMultiEnum, a PHP class extending TemplateEnum, used for handling multi-select enum fields in SuiteCRM, including methods for rendering HTML, preparing data for saving, and retrieving field definitions.

classes.name: TemplateMultiEnum
classes.description: A PHP class for multi-select enum field handling in SuiteCRM, providing methods for rendering, data processing, and field definition.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing the multi-select enum field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Returns template variables for editing the field, including options and help text.

methods.name: prepSave
methods.description: Placeholder method for preparing data before saving.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns the detail view template variables.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns template variables for the detail view, including translated selected options.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including multi-select properties and default values.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns default database value for the field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field data, encoding multi-select values and serializing dependencies.
